item.title: Ex-ByteDance Executive Chen Lin Returns with AI Education Startup Galaxy Zhixue
item.description:
Chen Lin, former senior vice president of ByteDance, founded Galaxy Zhixue in December 2024 and used an education technology conference to detail the architecture of its product Xiaolu Aixue. The system pairs the Doubao foundation model with a self-developed learning engine built on deep knowledge tracing, item response theory and cognitive diagnosis, aiming to diagnose how students learn rather than merely generate solutions. The disclosure remains architectural and conceptual, with no verified large-scale classroom outcome data yet.

原文标题：陈林再创业银河智学 用双核架构切入课堂

Why it matters：明星创业者入局教育 AI 并披露具体技术栈，对关注垂直行业落地路径的读者有参考价值，但缺乏可验证效果数据。

item.title: Anthropic Kicks Off IPO Roadshow at $1.4 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic has officially launched its IPO roadshow, planning to offer 825 million shares at $70-78 each for a deal size of up to roughly $64.35 billion, with trading on Nasdaq under ticker ANT expected November 19. Amid a broad AI sector selloff, its potential valuation has fallen from about $2 trillion to roughly $1.4 trillion, a drop of around 30%, while early shareholders could cash out $22.1-24.6 billion on day one.

原文标题：Anthropic 启动 IPO 路演 估值缩水至 1.4 万亿美元

Why it matters：这是 AI 行业史上最大规模 IPO 之一的关键节点，估值缩水与市场恐慌情绪对判断 AI 资本周期具有重要参考价值。

item.title: Australia Drafts Law Mandating Independent Safety Audits for Frontier AI Models
item.description:
Australia's Albanese government unveiled its first mandatory safety law for frontier AI models, requiring developers to submit to independent audits, run continuous safety checks, publish safety frameworks, and report incidents immediately. A new oversight body will enforce compliance alongside the Australian AI Safety Institute with steep penalties, with details to follow public consultation.

原文标题：澳大利亚拟立法强制前沿模型接受独立安全审计

Why it matters：这是主要经济体首次以立法形式强制前沿模型开放独立审计，对全球 AI 监管走向与厂商合规成本有直接参考价值。

item.title: Grok Build Apps Expose 35,000 Unauthenticated Endpoints
item.description:
Security firm Claroc found that over 35,000 apps built with Grok are accessible without authentication, with roughly 650 to 800 containing private data, including internal sales tools and employee performance records from SpaceXSI, X and Tesla, plus ICU patient records and plaintext credentials. The root cause is that Grok assigns each app a hard-to-guess random subdomain but relies on obscurity rather than real access control. Apps created by SpaceXSI and X employees have been taken offline, while many third-party apps remain exposed.

原文标题：Grok 构建应用泄露 3.5 万个未授权访问入口

Why it matters：头部 AI 编程平台出现大规模鉴权缺失导致真实机密外泄，是 AI 应用安全范式的标志性事件。

item.title: Hong Kong Launches First HarmonyOS Government App iAM Smart
item.description:
Hong Kong's Digital Policy Office and Huawei Device kicked off development of a HarmonyOS edition of the iAM Smart platform on November 9, making it the territory's first HarmonyOS government app. With over 1,400 services and 4.9 million users, the adaptation targets cross-border HarmonyOS device users and hardened identity authentication.

item.title: MSI Net Profit Jumps 153.9% to NT$10.45 Billion in First Three Quarters
item.description:
MSI reported NT$10.45 billion in net profit for the first three quarters of 2026, up 153.9% year over year, even as revenue fell 5.5%. With memory prices squeezing PC costs, the company is expanding into NVIDIA MGX-based rack-scale AI infrastructure and liquid-cooled GPU servers.

原文标题：微星前三季净利 104.49 亿新台币 同比增 153.9%

Why it matters：PC 硬件厂商在存储涨价周期中的利润异动，叠加其向 AI 服务器业务的延伸，值得产业读者关注。

item.title: SMIC Net Profit Jumps 91.6% to 7.31 Billion Yuan in First Nine Months
item.description:
SMIC reported 60.62 billion yuan in revenue and 7.31 billion yuan in net profit for the first nine months of 2026, up 22.4% and 91.6% year over year, driven by higher wafer shipments, rising utilization and an improved product mix. Third-quarter revenue reached 21.98 billion yuan with net profit of 2.85 billion yuan, as utilization climbed above the prior quarter's 93.7% and 12-inch wafers rose to 78.9% of mix.

原文标题：中芯国际前三季净利 73.14 亿元同比增 91.6%

Why it matters：中国大陆最大晶圆代工厂盈利接近翻倍，产能利用率与 12 英寸占比走高，是观察本土 AI 算力供给底座的关键财务信号。

item.title: Huawei Cloud to Unveil CloudRobo Embodied World Model on November 16
item.description:
Huawei Cloud has scheduled an online launch on November 16 for CloudRobo-WM1.2, the first Ascend-native world model under its Industry AI Dream Factory platform. The model targets embodied intelligence scenarios, consistent with Huawei Cloud's strategy of building platforms and models rather than robot hardware. Only the name and date have been disclosed so far, with no technical details yet.

item.description:
DAMAC founder Hussain Sajwani said at Bloomberg's Dubai investment forum that his stakes in OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic alone have earned billions of dollars, with his net worth now above $13 billion. He acknowledged valuation pullback risk, while Blackstone flagged digital infrastructure and compute demand as prime opportunities and PIMCO expected digital infrastructure lending growth to slow.

Why it matters：反映中东资本对头部 AI 公司的押注回报与估值分歧，是观察 AI 资产泡沫争论的一手信号。

item.title: ZTE Xuanji Builds Ontology-Driven Semantic Layer for Enterprise AI
item.description:
ZTE has introduced Xuanji, an ontology-driven semantic software platform aimed at filling the enterprise semantic gap left by LLMs and RAG. It organizes business knowledge as concepts, attributes, relations and rules, maps them to database tables, fields and APIs, and turns natural-language questions into structured queries and rule-based reasoning. The platform connects multi-source data below and exposes REST API, GUI, LUI, SDK, Webhook and Skills/Tool/MCP interfaces to agents and business applications across procurement, supply chain and finance.

原文标题：中兴璇玑以本体语义构建企业 AI 基础设施

Why it matters：提出以本体语义层补足企业 AI 语义缺口的架构思路，但属厂商授权转载，缺少参数与可验证落地数据。

item.title: South Korea Unveils 40 Million Dollar Edge AI Chip Roadmap for 2030
item.description:
South Korea's Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy unveiled a roadmap for edge AI semiconductor development, committing 800.2 billion won (about 400 million yuan) to complete development and validation of 10 AI chips by 2030. The chips target smart appliances, autonomous driving, collaborative and humanoid robots, agricultural robots, drones, plus advanced-node and extreme-environment projects, with Samsung and other foundries prioritizing MPW tape-out slots and IP vendors cutting design costs.

原文标题：韩国投 40 亿元推进端侧 AI 芯片 2030 年验证 10 款

Why it matters：国家级端侧 AI 芯片路线图落地，涉及代工产能与 IP 成本机制，是观察 AI 算力供应链区域化的重要信号。

item.title: Holiday Extras Rebuilds Core App with Codex in Two Weeks
item.description:
Travel technology company Holiday Extras extended its company-wide ChatGPT Enterprise rollout into software building with Codex, producing a fully working rebuild of its main app within two weeks and shifting from an annual release cycle to continuous iteration. CEO Matthew Pack uses Codex himself to reset the organization's expectations of what it can build.

item.title: Foxconn Warns Chip and Memory Shortages to Persist Through 2027
item.description:
Foxconn chairman Young Liu said AI demand will continue to outstrip supply in 2027, with tight chip, memory and key component availability persisting even as new capacity gradually comes online. He expects AI cloud products to exceed 60% of Foxconn's revenue within three to five years, while taking a cautious view of PCs as memory-driven price hikes may dampen upgrade demand.

原文标题：鸿海预警 2027 年芯片与内存供需持续吃紧

Why it matters：全球最大电子代工厂掌门人对 AI 算力供应链瓶颈给出明确时间判断，是观察算力基础设施景气度的重要产业信号。

item.title: Meta Infrastructure Chief to Step Down After 17 Years, Amazon Veteran to Succeed
item.description:
Meta has confirmed that Santosh Janardhan, its long-serving infrastructure head and co-lead of engineering, will step down, with Dave Brown, a former Amazon executive who joined Meta earlier this year, taking over. Janardhan will stay through the transition as an advisor to Meta Compute before departing next year. The handover comes as Meta sharply scales AI data center investment, putting a new leader atop a critical infrastructure unit.

原文标题：Meta 基础设施负责人卸任 亚马逊老将接棒

Why it matters：Meta 在 AI 算力竞赛关键期更换基础设施掌舵人，涉及数据中心投资战略走向，值得关注。

item.title: Omdia Forecasts Global AI Software Revenue to Top $200 Billion This Year
item.description:
Omdia's latest forecast puts global AI software revenue above $200 billion in 2026, doubling 2024 levels, with generative AI revenue up 139% year over year. Over 2025-2031 the market is projected to grow at roughly 30% CAGR, while agentic AI leads at 104% CAGR and generative AI is expected to overtake predictive AI revenue by 2028.

原文标题：Omdia 预计今年全球 AI 软件收入突破 2000 亿美元

Why it matters：这是一份覆盖 AI 软件整体盘子与智能体增速的权威市场预测，为判断行业景气度与赛道结构变化提供量化锚点。

item.title: TrendForce Forecasts PC DRAM Prices to Climb 18% in Q4
item.description:

item.title: CXMT Says Server Memory Demand Now Exceeds Half of Total Market
item.description:
CXMT VP Luo Xiaodong said at the IC Entrepreneurs Conference that AI compute demand has pushed memory into a stratified era, with servers now accounting for over 50% of memory demand and DRAM demand set to grow 21% annually from 2026 to 2030. The company expects DRAM shortages to persist and Q4 revenue to keep rising on strong server customer demand.

原文标题：长鑫科技：服务器内存需求占比已超 50%

Why it matters：国产 DRAM 龙头首次明确服务器内存需求占比过半，是观察 AI 算力对存储结构性拉动的一手产业信号。

item.title: Japan Weighs Penalties for AI Firms Over Frontier Model Risks
item.description:
Japan is advancing a regulatory overhaul that would oblige AI firms to meet safety obligations and allow the government to issue enforcement orders, with penalties for non-compliant companies after frontier AI incidents such as loss of control or cyberattacks. The full reform plan is expected by year-end, while the scope of covered firms, including US model developers, remains under discussion.

原文标题：日本拟立法处罚前沿 AI 失控企业

Why it matters：这是主要经济体首次明确以处罚手段约束前沿 AI 失控风险，标志 AI 监管从倡导转向强制执法。

item.title: Anthropic Glasswing Finds 38,000 Flaws but Fixes Only 217
item.description:
VulnCheck's tracking shows that seven months into Anthropic's Project Glasswing, Claude has produced 37,966 candidate vulnerabilities while only 217 have been recorded as fixed publicly, with roughly 12,000 new candidates but just 15 new fixes in the past two months. With 419 retractions and 1,654 duplicates, the data exposes a severe mismatch between AI-driven vulnerability discovery and the open-source community's capacity to remediate.

原文标题：Anthropic 玻璃翼计划挖出 3.8 万漏洞仅修复 217 条

Why it matters：以具体追踪数据揭示 AI 安全挖洞与修复闭环断裂，对关注 AI 安全落地的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: SK Hynix HBM4 Yield Tops 70 Percent as Mass Production Race Heats Up
item.description:
SK Hynix's HBM4 yield has reportedly surpassed 70%, a level that could lift output by roughly 16.7% at equal production input versus 60%, seen as the key variable for mass-production competitiveness in next-gen high-bandwidth memory. Samsung is said to be near 80% and Micron is pushing hard, with early HBM4 yield and stable supply expected to shape future market share.

原文标题：SK 海力士 HBM4 良率突破 70% 加速量产竞赛

Why it matters：HBM4 良率是决定 AI 算力供给与成本的硬指标，头部三家厂商的良率竞赛直接影响下一代加速卡的产能节奏。

item.title: Runway Open-Sources 27B Robotics Model Praxis-1
item.description:
Runway released Praxis-1, an open-weight robotics control model built on a 27B-parameter video foundation model under Apache 2.0, runnable and fine-tunable on local hardware. Runway claims it completes robotic arm tasks 15.6x faster than a GPT-6 Astra-driven setup at 1/51 the per-task cost, leading the world-action-model category on the RoboLab-120 benchmark.

原文标题：Runway 开源 270 亿参数机器人模型 Praxis-1

Why it matters：视频预训练迁移到真实机器人控制并开放权重，是具身智能路线的重要节点。

item.title: Hygon Targets 2027 Mass Production of Next-Gen CPU to Match Global Peers
item.description:
Hygon Information general manager Sha Chaoqun said at the SSE International Investors Conference that the company expects to mass-produce its next-generation CPU next year with performance benchmarked against international peers, arguing compute infrastructure has shifted from single-chip to system-level competition. Its portfolio spans DCUs for LLM training, CPUs for AI data centers, and edge chips integrating CPU, GPU and NPU, under a sell-verify-develop cadence.

item.description:
苹果在新博文中首次公开智能家居中枢 HomeView 的人员识别流程：通过 Center Stage 摄像头与麦克风在安全隔离区内完成人脸与声纹特征提取和匹配，最多识别 6 位家庭成员，系统主进程仅收到“谁、在哪、把握多大”的结论，原始图像与音频不出隔离区。该设计将生物识别与个性化体验绑定在端侧安全架构上，是苹果在家庭场景隐私计算的重要落地。
